- **Anthracnose**: Shows dark acervuli on pods/stems but no white cottony growth inside pods

The white fluffy/cottony mycelium inside the pod, combined with the darkly discolored seed (likely a sclerotium), is the hallmark of White Mold (*Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*).
